title: The shadow of a spinning black hole: rays traced along its edge, against Bardeen's outline
x: across the spin axis, seen from afar (GM/c²)
note: The edge rays spiral toward Bardeen's spherical photon orbits: each must have its orbit's η = Q/E², to the tracer's error. spin 0.5 at 30°: η off by 1.2e-12 (limit 3.8e-9); spin 0.9 at 60°: η off by 1.6e-11 (limit 7.3e-9); spin 0.9 at 90°: η off by 1.6e-11 (limit 8.2e-9); spin 0.99 at 90°: η off by 7.9e-11 (limit 2.2e-8).
